Maya: Hey team, quick quarterly patterns sync. The scan flagged three persistent themes: tenant burst overload, cache prefix thrash, and deploy-induced perf regressions. Need owners + one-liner acceptance + ETA so we can create follow-ups in the tracker.
Diego: I'll take tenant burst overload. Acceptance: top 5 offender tenants get <2s p99 for user-facing calls under 2x burst after mitigations. ETA: 2026-05-14.
Hanna: I can own cache prefix thrash. Acceptance: synthetic replay shows >=85% reduction in eviction cascades. ETA: 2026-05-07.
Arun: I'll take deploy perf regressions. Acceptance: block deploys with >10% p95 regressions via perf-gate; ETA: 2026-04-28.
Maya: Which need infra help or tickets?
Diego: Need per-tenant throttles and burst quotas (INFRA ticket).
OncallBot: New ticket created: INFRA-3200 "per-tenant burst quotas + throttle hooks" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3200
Hanna: Need kernel tuning window for eviction experiments, will request a test slot.
Arun: Need a small pipeline hook in eng-runtime for perf-gate evaluation; will file REQ.
Maya: Please include originating PMT id when you open PRs so tracker can auto-close. Also add a 1-liner regression test for each fix.
Diego: Will reference PMT-2155 and add a test.
Hanna: Using PMT-2162, will add synthetic replay job to CI.
Arun: PMT-2148 referenced, adding perf-gate unit and integration tests.
Maya: I'll add rows in the incident-patterns tracker and schedule weekly check-ins. OncallBot: set recurring reminder?
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in every Mon 10:00 UTC for this thread.
Diego: One more ask: for long-running tenant mitigations, recommend CS escalate to account managers. I'll prepare a short recommendation text.
Maya: Good call. I'll add a 'tenant mitigation' column. Thanks all, will follow up after tracker is created.
